recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-3120 unless a future work-group decision changes canonical-resource versioning guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-3120 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire change request asking for a Questionnaire business version comparable to profiles and value sets, with version changes driven by form-content changes rather than metadata-only changes.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-3120-tagged commit was found. The May 2014 git-svn commit 54ddc30bbb split Questionnaire/QuestionnaireResponse and applied most outstanding Questionnaire change requests, adding Questionnaire.version to the legacy spreadsheet as a 0..1 string for the publisher-assigned business version that may remain unchanged across resource updates.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition defines Questionnaire.version as the business version, the current Questionnaire search-parameter bundle exposes Questionnaire.version, and general resource guidance distinguishes business versions from record versions. A 2024 #questionnaire Zulip thread continues to interpret Questionnaire.version as the business version. FHIR-26370 later added versionAlgorithm support but did not supersede Questionnaire.version.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because the authoritative current source already satisfies the requested business-version support and no conflicting later decision was found.

related_jiras.note: Added versionAlgorithm support for determining the most recent version of canonical resources, including Questionnaire, without replacing Questionnaire.version.
